"Air Woosh Move" by Almitory, OpenGameArt.org (https://opengameart.org/content/air-woosh-move)
  depart.mp3        <- air_move.wav (trimmed to 1.2 s with a fade-out)

Converted to mono 96 kbps MP3 with leading silence trimmed.
